scenes.say: Gold shoots up. And often comes back.

scenes.text: A gap left behind by a strong impulse.
scenes.say: This is a Fair Value Gap: a gap left behind by a strong impulse.

scenes.title: Spot it: wicks of candle 1 and 3 *don't overlap*
scenes.caption: The gap in between is the Fair Value Gap.
scenes.say: Step one: the wicks of candle one and three don't overlap. The gap lies in between.

scenes.title: Wait for price to come back *into the gap*
scenes.caption: Don't chase the impulse.
scenes.say: Step two: wait for price to come back into the gap. Don't chase it.

scenes.text: Enter inside the gap – stop beyond the gap.
scenes.say: Step three: enter inside the gap, stop beyond it.

scenes.text: Trading every gap. Only gaps in the trend direction count.
scenes.say: Common mistake: trading every gap. Only gaps in the trend direction count.

scenes.title: Gold. With a plan.
